liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cold Rain and Snow** (1 review): The first set features a fired up and charging version of this song [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-04-06.143050.fob.nak700.wise.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 165 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd82-04-06.aud.dipietro.16768.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 163 min; rated 4.36/5 by 24 [3]. Said about its sound: Jerry plays a delicious lead guitar during the performance of Morning Dew; The second set is described as crystal clear and divine by the listener [12][15]
- **gd1982-04-06.170781.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 170 min [6]
- **gd82-04-06.sbd-patched.wiley.16785.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 163 min; rated 4.09/5 by 22 [9]. Said about its sound: Pitch appears fine, though the reviewer notes the playing and quality are great; The recording sounds saturated with some distortion present in the louder material [14][18]

## Around the show

- Bobby sings about a sex change during the transition from Space to Truckin [12]
- Stage colors change visibly while the band plays the short verse of The Other One [16]
- Four to six inches of snow covered the ground outside the Spectrum after the show [17]
- Weather was unseasonably cold and rainy, prompting a witty song about clothes [19]
- Reviewer considers the second set a must-listen and a personal favorite [10]
- Reviewer rates the second set well but finds the overall show unexciting [11]
- Shakedown Street is cited as the best version ever of that song [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-04-06.143050.fob.nak700.wise.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Bob Wagner's Sony TC-D5M > Jim's Sony TC-D5M (Maxell… [1]. Also: Jim Wise recorded the show and provided a fresh transcription of his FOB master; Charlie Miller coordinated the effort for the audience recording release [1]
- **gd82-04-06.aud.dipietro.16768.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [3]
- **gd1982-04-06.170781.nak700.wagner.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 (w/ Bass EQ) > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B) [6]. Also: Bob Wagner provided the master cassettes for this specific recording source; Charlie Miller transferred the tapes and coordinated the release effort; A 0:32 patch in Drums was supplied from cdiprieto's FOB audience source [6]
- **gd82-04-06.sbd-patched.wiley.16785.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Gregg Nixon Grateful Dead: [1982-04-05 The Spectrum, Philadelphia, PA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-04-05-the-spectrum-philadelphia-pa-usa/) [23]
